fieldNotes._addressDiscrepancy: ROSTER vs DOSSIER mismatch. The roster address 18735 S Ferris Pl, Compton CA geocodes to the existing Total Transportation Services (TTSI) headquarters building (PropertyShark/LoopNet: ~118,740 sq ft warehouse, built 1998). TTSI acquired SalSon Logistics in Sept 2022, so SalSon Logistics Services LLC (USDOT 3968944) is registered at the TTSI corporate campus. The dossier separately describes a 'brand-new West Compton site, still under construction, 260,000 sq ft, 66 dock doors, 20-acre secured yard' — that is a DIFFERENT, future facility with no public street address. This audit covers the building at the roster address (the operational TTSI/SalSon Compton warehouse), not the unbuilt West Compton site.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck gate at the property line. Street View (2025) shows an open paved driveway off S Ferris Place leading into the dock/truck court between buildings, with no barrier arm or sliding gate. Flagged uncertain — interior court fencing/gates within the multi-tenant logistics park were not fully resolvable.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible at the driveway entrance or building front in Street View or satellite.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Loading docks on the NW face of the building facing a shared drive-court; ~30 doors estimated with trailers backed in (including SalSon-yellow trailers). 25-50 band, flagged uncertain due to shared-court layout.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer/container drop staging in the truck court SW of the building; 10-25 band estimate.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep paved drive-court between building rows gives ample truck queuing depth.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single warehouse building at this parcel (the office/HQ structure with an attached distribution warehouse). It sits within a larger multi-tenant logistics park but is one building.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Rancho Dominguez / Compton industrial fabric in metro Los Angeles; Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into this parcel.
fieldNotes.confidence: Medium overall — the building is positively located but the roster address resolves to the TTSI corporate campus rather than the dossier's '260K sq ft under construction' West Compton facility; the ungated open-court layout and dock counts are honest estimates from a shared logistics-park court.
